prompt:
主題：
木陰の小花ビキニ

主体：
南国の木造パビリオンに置かれた白いデイベッドで、成人女性が小花柄ビキニ姿で膝立ちする縦位置写真。 人物は画面中央を基準に配置する。

人物・表情：
濡れた肩下の濃茶髪と薄い前髪。細い卵形輪郭、横長の茶色い目、自然な眉、小ぶりな鼻、艶のある桃色の唇。正面へ柔らかく微笑む。

服装・ポーズ：
生成り地に桃色の小花柄の三角ホルタービキニ、細い首紐、両腰を結ぶ同柄ボトム。白い寝具の上で膝立ちし、両腕を体の前へ自然に下ろす。 小花柄の水着。 三角カップから細い肩紐が伸びる。

背景・光：
木の手すり、白い枕、濃い熱帯植物と橙色の花。木漏れ日が濡れた髪、肩、布へ細かな明暗を作る。 画面背景の主光は画面左からの柔らかな光。

構図・カメラ：
3:4の縦構図、カメラは正面からの腰下寄り。人物を中央へ大きく置き、白い寝具で下半身を囲み、緑を後景にする。顔と小花柄に焦点。 人物を大きく収め、主役へ焦点を合わせ、背景は軽いボケ。 腰上写真。

質感・スタイル：
フォトリアルなリゾート写真。濡れた毛束、水滴、小花柄の布、白い寝具、木漏れ日の肌を自然に精細に写す。

ネガティブ：
生成り地の小花柄と濡れた髪を単色の乾いた姿へ変えない

promptTranslations.en:
Subject:
Small Floral Bikini in the Shade of Trees

Main Subject:
A vertical photograph of an adult woman kneeling on a white daybed placed in a tropical wooden pavilion, wearing a small floral bikini. The subject is positioned based around the center of the frame.

Person / Expression:
Wet dark brown hair reaching below the shoulders with thin bangs. Slender oval face contour, wide brown eyes, natural eyebrows, petite nose, and glossy pink lips. Softly smiling toward the front.

Clothing / Pose:
Triangle halter bikini with pink small floral patterns on an off-white base, thin neck ties, and matching bottoms tied at both hips. Kneeling on white bedding, both arms naturally lowered in front of the body. Small floral print swimwear. Thin shoulder straps extend from the triangle cups.

Background / Lighting:
Wooden railings, white pillows, dense tropical plants, and orange flowers. Dappled sunlight filtering through trees creates intricate chiaroscuro on the wet hair, shoulders, and fabric. The primary light in the background is soft light coming from the left side of the frame.

Composition / Camera:
3:4 vertical composition, camera facing from the front slightly below waist level. The subject is placed prominently in the center, with the white bedding surrounding the lower body and lush greenery in the background. Focus on the face and the small floral pattern. Capturing the subject prominently, focusing on the main figure, with light bokeh in the background. Upper-body shot from the waist up.

Texture / Style:
Photorealistic resort photography. Naturally and intricately captures wet hair strands, water droplets, small floral fabric, white bedding, and skin bathed in dappled sunlight.

Negative:
Do not change the small floral pattern on the off-white base and wet hair into a solid-colored dry look

translations.zh:
主题：
树荫下的小碎花比基尼

主体：
在热带木造凉亭中的白色日间床上，一名成年女性身穿小碎花比基尼跪坐的竖构图照片。人物居中排列。

人物与表情：
过肩深褐色湿发配稀疏刘海。纤细鹅蛋脸、狭长棕眼、自然眉形、小巧鼻梁、水润粉唇。面向正面温柔微笑。

服装与姿势：
本白色底配粉色小碎花的三角挂脖比基尼，细颈绳，两侧系带同款泳裤。跪在白色寝具上，双臂自然垂于身前。小碎花泳衣。三角罩杯连着纤细肩带。

背景与光线：
木质扶手、白色枕头、繁茂热带植物和橙色花卉。树荫光影在湿发、肩膀和织物上形成细腻明暗。主光来自画面左侧的柔光。

构图与镜头：
3:4竖构图，镜头自正前方略低于腰部。人物居中特写，白色床品环绕下半身，绿色植物为背景。焦点对准面部和小碎花。大画幅聚焦主体，背景微虚。半身过腰照。

质感与风格：
写实度假风格照片。自然细腻展现湿发绺、水珠、碎花布料、白色寝具及受光肌肤。

负向提示：
切勿将本白色碎花与湿发变为单色干燥状态
translations.en:
Theme:
Floral bikini in tree shade

Subject:
Vertical photo of an adult woman in a floral bikini kneeling on a white daybed inside a tropical wooden pavilion, centered in frame.

Person & Expression:
Wet dark brown hair past shoulders with wispy bangs. Slender oval face, elongated brown eyes, natural brows, petite nose, glossy pink lips, smiling softly toward front.

Attire & Pose:
Off-white triangular halter bikini with pink floral pattern, thin neck straps, matching tie-side bottoms. Kneeling on white bedding, arms hanging naturally forward.

Background & Light:
Wooden railing, white pillows, lush tropical plants with orange flowers. Dappled sunlight creates contrast on wet hair, shoulders, and fabric. Soft key light from the left.

Composition & Camera:
3:4 vertical framing, front waist-level angle. Subject centered with white bedding surrounding lower body, green foliage background, soft blur. Focused on face and floral print.

Texture & Style:
Photorealistic resort photography capturing wet hair strands, water droplets, floral fabric, and sunlit skin with fine detail.

Negative:
Do not alter the off-white floral pattern and wet hair into a solid, dry appearance
